style: 外見・年齢感・服装は美術設定。声を失った原因・性別・氏名を本文へ追加しない。口を閉じ、空の手で小さく拍を送る。録音の歌手を別人として描かない。

files.prompt_en:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: transparent full-body character portrait for a Japanese fantasy adventure game
Primary request: one anonymous former choir singer, now a conductor who has lost their voice, calmly giving a small beat with empty hands and keeping the mouth gently closed. Focused, dignified expression. The past recorded singing belongs to this same person.
Scene/backdrop: fully transparent background, isolated figure only
Style/medium: finely drawn ink outlines, soft layered watercolor and opaque painted shading, restrained storybook fantasy illustration, warm natural skin tones and nuanced fabric folds
Subject: adult conductor with short softly waved dark hair touched with silver, muted plum long tunic, charcoal sleeveless outer robe, simple cloth waist sash and practical dark shoes. Ordinary unadorned clothing.
Composition/framing: vertical 1024 by 1536 canvas, entire standing figure and both hands visible, head in upper fifth with generous transparent margin above, narrow balanced silhouette within central 65 percent, feet fully inside canvas. Hands at chest height with fingers naturally spaced, one guiding a small beat. Three-quarter front view, readable face at small display size.
Lighting/mood: soft even illumination, quiet concentration
Constraints: exactly one person, closed mouth, empty hands, transparent alpha around the entire silhouette. No other people, duplicate figure, ghost, musical notes, sound effects, platform, furniture, room, floor, background, text, lettering, symbols or watermark. Clothing and physical appearance are art direction only; do not depict a cause of voice loss.
files.prompt_ja: 用途：物語用イラスト。日本語ファンタジーADVの透過全身人物画。声を失い、現在は指揮を執る匿名の元聖歌隊員を一人だけ描く。口を穏やかに閉じ、空いた両手で小さく拍を送り、落ち着いた集中と尊厳のある表情にする。過去の録音の歌声もこの本人のもの。繊細なインク線と水彩の重なり、不透明な塗りによる柔らかな陰影、抑制した物語画。銀色が少し混じる短く波打つ暗い髪、くすんだ梅色の長衣、墨色の袖なし上衣、簡素な布帯と実用的な暗い靴。装飾のない日常着。1024×1536の縦長画面に全身と両手を収め、頭は上部5分の1に置いて上の透過余白を確保し、中央65％以内にまとまる輪郭にする。足先を切らず、胸の高さの手で自然に拍を示す。斜め前向きで縮小しても顔を読める構図。柔らかく均等な光。背景と全身の周囲は完全透過。人物は一人、口は閉じ、手には物を持たせない。他の人物、分身、幽霊、音符、音の効果、台、家具、部屋、床、背景、文字、記号、透かしを入れない。外見と衣装は美術設定で、声を失った原因を描写しない。
